title: Children’s gambling-like experiences
description: A 2026–27 Penn State research project examines children’s exposure to online gambling and related risks, with a focus on harm reduction.

funding.funder: Penn State College of Information Sciences and Technology
funding.program: Seed Grant Program: Risk Exposure and Harm Reduction in Children’s Online Gambling

label: Youth / Wellbeing
longDescription: Building on the lab’s studies of teenagers’ gambling discussions on Reddit, gamblification on Twitch, and gambling-like design on Roblox, this Penn State College of IST seed-funded project examines children’s exposure to online gambling and related risks, and how harm can be reduced.
leadership: PIs: Xinning Gui and Yubo Kou.
